newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 22.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Financial institutions to be allowed to sell debt portfolios to individuals around fiscal 1998/99.
-- Japanese, U.S. chip makers to focus on high-tech investments.
-- 'Monju' fast-breeder reactor to be transferred to new body as part of Power Reactor and Nuclear Fuel Development Corp (PNC) overhaul.
All senior Nomura Securities Co Ltd board members to give up rights to represent company.
-- The Management and Coordination Agency to urge the Post and Telecommunications Ministry to abide by upper limit for postal savings.
-- The Health and Welfare Ministry neglected report on Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease for seven months.
